summary: A local guide to summer water activities in the region, covering surfing, kayaking, white-water rafting, paddleboarding, sailing, snorkeling and diving, water parks, and fishing. Each section names a venue, the people running it, and a recent September 2023 start or opening date. It encourages readers of all experience levels to try water sports while respecting the water and prioritizing safety.
one_line: A guide to local summer water activities, from surfing and kayaking to rafting, sailing, diving and fishing, with venues, instructors and September 2023 openings.
key_facts: Liberty Beach installed a state-of-the-art wave pool on September 5th, 2023, and surf instructors Mike Hanson and Lisa Gerrard teach beginners.
The Bluebell River kayak rental service has expanded since September 15th, thanks to local couple Tom and Marissa Greenleaf.
Roaring Adventures, a rafting company on the Falcon River, was founded by Jack O'Reilly on September 12th, 2023.
The Falcon River is known for challenging rapids, and rafting trips are tailored to different experience levels.
Angela Hart, a local fitness guru, started the "Paddle for Health" stand-up paddleboarding program at Crystal Lake on September 20th, 2023.
Sunshine Marina offers sailing lessons for beginners and boat rentals for experienced sailors starting from September 8th; Everett Jones is among the instructors.
Pickerel Pond became an official snorkeling and diving zone as of September 22nd, with visibility up to 30 feet on a good day.
Dive master Emily Clarkson has started offering guided tours at Pickerel Pond.
Splash Town Water Park opened September 18th and offers slides, wave pools, and lazy rivers, plus lounging areas for parents.
Whispering Pines and Serenity Lake are well stocked with bass, trout, and catfish.
Fishing licenses became available electronically since September 10th, 2023.
Henry Cooper offers weekend workshops on the basics of fishing.
